title: Coastlines
summary: EXAMPLE ONLY. Coastlines: 12 new abstract seascapes by Ritushka at NITA Gallery, Surry Hills, 5 February to 14 March 2027. Free entry.
body: EXAMPLE TEXT. Coastlines brings together twelve new paintings made over a year of walking the coast between Shoreham and the Apostles.
Each work is built in translucent layers of acrylic, so the colour shifts as the light in the room changes through the day.

quote.text: I paint what stays with me after I leave the beach.
